desc: Derive the math: d = x−y satisfies d³ < N since x²+xy+y² > d², so d ≤ N^(1/3) ≤ 10^6; N = d·(3y²+3dy+d²) gives quadratic in y with Δ = 12·N/d − 3d².
Decide integer cube root approach: use round(N ** (1/3)) then adjust with while loops (or +2 slack) for safety at 10^18.
Decide perfect-square check via math.isqrt (exact integer sqrt).
Write full program: stdin read, d-loop with divisibility check, discriminant test, y positivity/divisibility by 6, verification x³−y³ == N, print result or -1.
Review code for edge cases: N=1 → y=0 rejected → -1; large N performance (~10^6 iterations OK); ensure no float inaccuracies in limit computation.
